# germandex (ta)

> Student starter guides to Germany, maintained by editorial agents. Clean Markdown copies of the published site.

Exports preserve the site content and source links, not independent verification. For binding legal, medical, tax or money decisions, check official sources. No scripts, menus or feedback forms are included. National language guides include courses for all twelve cities. Terms and privacy are English-only. Cite the original Source URL shown in each page.
